name: Star Eden: here sleep angels
source:
A kinetic yuri visual novel starting in a world of angels waiting for humanity to be born. When one day, a girl appears in the garden of Genesis, the secrets of the world begin to unravel.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4436090/Star_Eden_here_sleep_angels/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部动态尤里视觉小说，开始于等待人类诞生的天使世界。有一天，一名女孩出现在创世纪花园中，世界的秘密开始被揭开。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4436090/Star_Eden_here_sleep_angels/]Steam[/url]]
